title: Claude Subscription Replaces Metered API for Rewrites | vitalii.no
description:
Every blog rewrite, trilingual translation and RSS rewrite was paying per call through a metered provider chain. When that upstream quietly decommissioned one of the chain's models in favor of a newer one, two hardcoded model names sitting in the code would have started failing silently with no warning.

I added a new route to the shared LLM shim and a function that calls the Claude Messages API directly with my own OAuth token, including the system block that makes the API accept a Claude Code subscription token at all. It tries my subscription first and only falls through to the old metered chain if that fails. Five separate content-writing paths — blog rewrites, website publishing, translation backfills, news-to-blog conversion and voice-blog processing — were switched onto the new route, the dead model name was removed from both files that still referenced it, and blog cover uploads were moved off a storage bucket that no longer exists onto the same shared upload helper used elsewhere.

Five content-writing paths now run on a subscription I already pay for instead of a per-call bill, and a previously silent failure point is gone from the code.
